intentions: Define and manage category entities with unique names, descriptions, and optional reorder thresholds
Define and manage product entities with unique SKUs, category references, price in cents, stock quantity, and low-active flag
Implement a CategoryRepository to handle CRUD operations and retrieve products within a category using SQLite with foreign key support
Implement a ProductRepository to handle CRUD operations, filter products by category, identify low-stock items, and compute total stock value per category
Develop an InventoryService to encapsulate business logic including product validation, updates, deletions, stock adjustments, and reporting
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested command groups for product and category operations, including filtering and reporting
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point inaccuracies
Use auto-incremented primary keys with optional ID fields in domain models
Implement custom exception classes for CategoryNotFoundError and ProductNotFoundError to improve error handling
Ensure SQLite database uses foreign key constraints to maintain data integrity
